title: Jensen Huang scheduled to testify next week in Senate following reinstatement as Nvidia CEO | TechCrunch
summary: It’s worth noting that before his reinstatement as CEO, Huang had already agreed to appear before the House Foreign Affairs Committee, the Select Committee on the Chinese Communist Party, and the House Intelligence Committee on December 1.
